f4_elevated_caution_label.timing: ENTRY-ACTIONABLE (label is in the entry message)
f4_elevated_caution_label.finding: present 5W/0L/2P vs absent 15W/6L/5P — his own HIGH RISK label paradoxically marks zero-loss trades (heightened-alert days: J09, J13, J26 monster, J28 campaign, S1-era). Suggested weight +1 (provisional).
f4_elevated_caution_label.caveat: n=7; correlates with f2; ~20% chance any single feature this common shows 0/6 losses by luck

f2_small_size_language.finding: present 5W/0L/3P (entry-scope 4W/0L/3P) vs absent 15W/6L/4P — size-caution language accompanies no losses. NOTE: recorded as a TEXT feature; the shadow engine records the language, it NEVER derives sizing (no risk sizing in scope).
f2_small_size_language.caveat: overlaps f4 heavily; same multiple-comparisons caveat

f7_reason_stated.timing: SEMI-ACTIONABLE (reason usually posted within minutes of entry)
f7_reason_stated.finding: present 5W/0L/1P — explicit 'Reason for the sell/buy' posts correlate with wins (structured-thesis days).
f7_reason_stated.caveat: n=6; timing lag means a live scorer may only apply it as an upgrade after the reason arrives

f8_education_context.finding: present 0W/1L/2P vs absent 20W/5L/5P — teaching-mode threads produced no verified wins.
f8_education_context.caveat: n=3 — far too small; watch forward

f5_be_stop_management.finding: thread present 19W/2L/6P vs absent 1W/4L/1P — dramatic but OUTCOME-CONFOUNDED: BE-stop talk only happens after the trade reaches profit. Entry-scope presence (2 records, both L) is just the re-entry signal again (entry messages that OPEN by reporting a prior BE-stop are re-entries J10/J17) — already covered by R2b.
f5_be_stop_management.caveat: do not score; keep as management diagnostic beside the MAE feature

f1_news_event_language.finding: only 2 thread hits (both W), zero entry-scope hits — his text rarely flags news in advance. A real news feature needs an external economic-calendar join, not his language.

f6_layered_entry_management.finding: present 3W/1L/4P — mixed; it is his universal method narrated inconsistently.

carry_to_detector_v0_2: f2_small_size_language (+1 provisional, merged with f4 as one 'caution-language' feature to avoid double counting)
f7_reason_stated (+1 low weight, applied on arrival)
honesty_caveats: n=33 matched trades, only 6 losses — every zero-loss split has ~15-25% probability by chance for features of this prevalence; with 12 features tested, ~2 such splits are EXPECTED by luck. Nothing here is confirmed; everything is provisional until the >=15 forward-captured-trade sample exists.
f2/f4/f7 co-occur (conviction-day cluster) — they are one signal family, not three independent edges.
f5 thread-scope is outcome-caused (reverse causality) and must never be scored at entry.
All features derive from the poster's own language — adversarially fragile if he changes phrasing; forward TV-alert alignment remains the robust path.
